speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing increasing pain and swelling in your right knee, along with episodes of pain during urination, and a history of a painful, swollen left ankle. To understand the full picture, have you noticed any redness, warmth, or fever accompanying these symptoms?

DIAGNOSIS READY: This clinical presentation is highly suggestive of Reactive Arthritis (formerly Reiter's syndrome), characterized by the triad of arthritis, urethritis, and potential anterior uveitis. REQUEST IMAGES: Knee_XRay, Ankle_XRay.
